question: Should the existing “Show credits & extra usage” preference become a cross-provider control that hides credit sections for providers such as Augment as well as Cursor?
rationale: The branch deliberately changes behavior beyond the Cursor-specific request and alters what existing users see when an already-stored preference is disabled; source tests prove the implementation but cannot establish the intended permanent preference contract.

options.title: Approve cross-provider semantics
options.body: Keep the generalized model behavior after contributor proof confirms the enabled and disabled menu states for Cursor and a credit-bearing provider.

options.title: Limit the change to Cursor
options.body: Retain Cursor on-demand usage gating but restore the previous behavior for unrelated providers until their inclusion is separately approved.

recommendation.title: Approve cross-provider semantics
recommendation.body: Keep the generalized model behavior after contributor proof confirms the enabled and disabled menu states for Cursor and a credit-bearing provider.

likelyOwner.reason: Likely repository-level owner for the provider-menu preference contract; historical per-file ownership could not be established from the supplied read-only evidence.
